responsibility: Defines the common GCC target configuration for systems using the Linux kernel, including support for multiple selectable C libraries and optional flat-executable environments. It provides macros to query the active libc choice, emits Linux/GNU preprocessor builtins, selects the correct dynamic linker path for glibc/uClibc/Bionic/musl, adjusts include-directory ordering for musl, sets TARGET_HAS_BIONIC, and chooses the appropriate libc-function capability hook for normal Linux versus single-libc uClinux cases. This is the central OS-configuration header for Linux-specific libc and linker policy.
same_name_distinction: This is the central configuration header in the linux same-name group: it defines Linux libc-selection macros, dynamic-linker choice, builtins, musl include-order handling, and TARGET_HAS_BIONIC policy, while linux.cc implements the libc-capability hook and linux.opt only declares the libc-selection switches.
